comment: The maker names inputs 8 and 9 'I/II/III resonance CV' in configInput (src/sync3xl.cpp:61-62), which duplicates the name given to input 7. The code adds input 8 to the three filter corners and input 9 to the three filter-type knobs (src/sync3xl.cpp:550-551, 555-571), so the lines describe those and name the conflict. Parameter index 13, TRIG_BUTTON_PARAM, is declared in the enum but never given a widget, so no click can reach it and it gets no line and no tag; the tap tempo button is a separate parameter at index 26. The three resonance knobs share one line, as do the three frequency knobs and the three filter-type knobs, because the three channels are identical. The Subaudio setting divides every filter corner by 1000 (src/sync3xl.cpp filterVoltageToCoeff).
